summary: Phase 2 AI Feature 2 (AI Lender Matching Engine) tested end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 effective tests passing (POST /api/ai/lender-match contract, auth, 404, hard filters for LTV/min_loan/max_loan, self_employed/contractor/adverse exclusion via dedicated controlled clients, empty-result message, PATCH /api/cases/{id}/lender success+404, Borrower Score regression). Frontend: full UX verified — tabs render, Find Best Lenders triggers loading state then results, ranked cards with rank-badge/lender-name/proc-fee/reason/watch-out, select button updates lender_id, reload shows Current Lender badge + teal left border, Overview tab regression (Borrower Strength Score 85, Case Notes Timeline) still works.
critical_code_review_comments: Adviser ownership check in POST /api/ai/lender-match works, but `eligible` filter pulls lenders by `user_id == current_user.id` — for an adviser viewing a team-owned case the lender panel may be empty. Confirm desired behaviour for multi-tenant team setups (may need to use case.assigned_broker_id's panel).

Lender panel fixture pollution: previous test runs left TEST_Lender_X / TEST_FilterLender_SE in the admin user's lender panel (visible in the current production case). Consider a teardown sweep that deletes all lenders prefixed with TEST_ at the start of the suite. Not blocking — current tests delete their own lenders.

_parse_claude_json strips ```json fences but uses naive first '[' / last ']' search; if Claude embeds JSON arrays in any prose preamble (rare), parse may pick wrong slice. Current system_message instructs JSON-only so risk is low.

Frontend selectLender button: `disabled` styling differs between current vs already-selected vs others. The 'Select Lender' text remains on non-current cards even after a lender is chosen (only style changes). Consider showing 'Locked' or hiding text for clarity (minor UX).
seed_data_creation: Tests create temporary lenders/clients/cases and self-clean. Note: pre-existing TEST_Lender_X and TEST_FilterLender_SE artefacts found in admin lender panel (from prior runs).
